correctness.rationale: At alpha*=1+beta^-2 the seven interval endpoints ±1, ±beta^-1, ±beta^-2, ±beta^-3 give a full Markov partition. Direct branch-image and cell-length calculations yield the stated four-state reflection-lumped stochastic Q and invariant pi=(1,1,3-sqrt5,sqrt5-1)/4, giving r-mean=3/4. Characteristic polynomial t(t-1)(t²+beta^-2*t+beta^-4) implies three-step covariance recurrence for n>=1; initial C0,C1,C2,C3 and the geometric series give exact sigma²=sqrt5/32. Irreducible aperiodic finite-state Poisson-martingale CLT yields both stationary and normalized-Lebesgue initial laws with bounded initial bias. Independent symbolic transition/12-lag/resolvent calculations matched, but cannot themselves replace the Markov CLT.
